news.headline: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a “brazen campaign” of intellectual property theft
news.summary: Sony Music and Warner Bros. are suing Anthropic for allegedly training its AI on copyrighted music and content without permission—a "brazen campaign" of IP theft, according to the filing. The lawsuit underscores growing tension between entertainment giants and AI companies over training data practices, as the industry grapples with how copyright law applies to machine learning.

news.headline: The 'choose your own adventure' earnings: Why retailers are handling tariff refunds so differently
news.summary: Retailers are getting creative with tariff refunds—some passing savings to customers through lower prices, others pocketing the gains to pad margins. The inconsistent accounting approach is making earnings comparisons tricky this quarter.

educational.title: What Is Diversification, Really?
points: Diversification means spreading money across many assets, not just many stocks
It won't stop losses, but it stops one bad bet from wiping you out
Owning 10 tech stocks isn't diversified — that's still one sector's risk
True diversification spans asset classes: stocks, bonds, cash, real estate
The goal isn't more returns — it's smoother, more survivable ones
